## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the problem being solved.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Performance improvement or architectural refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update or refinement
- [ ] Security fix

## Areas Affected
- [ ] Web Application (`apps/web`)
- [ ] API Gateway (`apps/api`)
- [ ] AI Intelligence Core (`apps/ai`)
- [ ] Memory Engine & Vector Search
- [ ] Database Schema / Migrations
- [ ] Docker / Deployment Topology

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the monorepo styling and architecture standards
- [ ] I have executed `pnpm typecheck` and resolved all TypeScript errors
- [ ] I have executed `pnpm test` and all 25 Jest API suites pass cleanly
- [ ] I have verified that no sensitive credentials or `.env` files are staged
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation in `docs/` where applicable
- [ ] I have added unit or integration tests verifying the new behavior

## Screenshots / Evidence (if applicable)
Attach screenshots or test outputs demonstrating the verified functionality.
